lessons.title: Generate online prediction features before target updates
lessons.statement: When multi-label outputs are used as predictors for other outputs, compute all first-stage predictions before updating with current-row targets. Assert no current-row label enters prediction features and compare independent held-out loss with and without cross-label features. This is an online implementation using shared weight arrays, not a conventional frozen OOF stack. The fixed boundary238 must match generated feature layout; no isolated gain is shown.

for ID, x, y in data(train, label):

    # get predictions and train on all labels
    P=[]
    for k in K:
        p = predict(x, w[k])
        P.append(p)
       # update(alpha, w[k], n[k], x, p, y[k])
        if k<13:
           x[238+k]=p
        else:
           x[237+k]=p
        loss += logloss(p, y[k]) 
    for k,p in zip(K,P):
        p2 = predict2(x, w[k])
        update(alpha, w[k], n[k], x, p2, y[k])
        update2(alpha, w[k], n[k], x, p2, y[k])
        loss2 += logloss(p2, y[k])  # for progressive validation
